Bluelight Consulting is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for

  • Develop, track, and document all aspects of the project.

  • Communicate and document project quality and progress metrics.
  • Address and resolve project issues to ensure the project remains on track.
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

raw.description:
Forever On! From the start in 2008, T5 has been focused on supporting enterprise and hyperscale customers with customized data center solutions. Today, we remain dedicated to an unmatched level of quality that extends across the lifecycle of the core data center—from customized turnkey development, facilities management, and data center operations to specialized construction solutions worldwide.

The world’s largest companies trust T5 with their data center operations.

At T5, our success is driven by our people. With hundreds of engineers, technicians, and professional staff, we foster a culture of excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.

  • Commitment to Diversity & Military Veterans
  • Battle-Tested Leadership Experience
  • 100% Data Center Focused
  • Owner-Operator Mindset

Job Description

    The Senior Procurement Specialist – Construction enables the commercial execution of construction contracts across T5 projects by translating site-defined scope and vendor selections into structured, enforceable agreements aligned to cost, schedule, and risk objectives.

    This role partners closely with Construction and Preconstruction teams to convert project requirements into clear contractual frameworks, ensuring commercial terms, pricing structures, and risk allocation are well-defined and executable.

    Operating within a decentralized delivery model, site teams retain ownership of vendor sourcing and selection, while this role brings consistency, clarity, and discipline to the commercial and contractual components of those engagements.

    In addition to hands-on contract execution, this position strengthens site capability by providing real-time guidance, coaching, and practical support to improve scope definition, vendor comparison, and overall commercial decision-making.

Responsibilities

    • Translate awarded scopes and vendor selections into executable contracts, including scope definition, commercial terms, and contract structure
    • Lead contract negotiations to align pricing structures, risk allocation, and commercial frameworks with project requirements
    • Evaluate vendor proposals from a commercial perspective, identifying gaps in scope, pricing inconsistencies, and potential risk exposure
    • Structure agreements with clear inclusions, exclusions, cost drivers, and financial terms to support accurate project execution
    • Partner with Construction and Preconstruction teams to ensure project requirements are clearly defined and contractually aligned
    • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, and internal stakeholders to resolve commercial and contractual considerations
    • Prepare and route agreements through internal approval workflows to support timely execution
    • Provide real-time commercial guidance to site teams during vendor engagement and proposal review
    • Coach site leads on scope clarity, vendor comparison, and commercial best practices to improve decision quality
    • Promote consistent use of templates, playbooks, and standardized contracting approaches to improve efficiency and scalability
    • Identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes, including cost structure optimization and contracting efficiency
    • Support end-to-end contract execution activities, ensuring alignment with internal systems and documentation standards

Qualifications

    • 8+ years of experience in construction procurement, preconstruction, or commercial contracting
    • Strong understanding of construction cost structures, contract frameworks, and risk allocation principles
    • Proven experience negotiating complex commercial agreements in a project-based environment
    • Experience working cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Construction, and Operations teams
    • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, project-driven environment
    • Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
    • Ability to influence and guide stakeholders without direct authority

Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision
    • 401(k) with match
    • PTO and paid holidays
    • Bonus eligible
T5 Data Centers is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

raw.description:
Overview

Nurse Practitioner Per Diem

This position covers all zip codes in: Garland County, AR

ComplexCare Solutions (CCS) specializes in helping those in need by delivering high-value home and virtual assessments for health plans nationwide. We pride ourselves on our member engagement aimed towards evaluating current health status, gaps in care, potential health risks and care management opportunities with a focus on driving better clinical outcomes.

CCS, on behalf of SME Medical Delaware, P.A., is calling on Advanced Practice Providers that are passionate about helping their local communities. We care dearly about those whom we serve, and we need your help to make a difference in the lives of our members. Providers have the opportunity to spend a full hour with these members, which allows them to capture a comprehensive picture of that individual’s personal needs and what is required to keep them in the home and out of the hospital.

Compensation:

  • Pay Range: $2,400.00 - $10,000.00 per month (Potential income) Earnings will vary based on completed assessments, state of residence, and business needs as there is no guarantee of visits or minimum income
  • In-home visit rate: $120 - $140 depending on state of residence
  • If available, our telehealth rate is $85 per completed assessment

Benefit:

This position is eligible to participate in a company 401K plan providing the opportunity to save for retirement through employee contributions. New hires will be automatically enrolled in the company 401(k) plan at a 3% contribution rate with the option to opt out.

Responsibilities

  • Knowledge of CMS Regulations and NCQA HEDIS Guidelines
  • Knowledge of Evidence-based Clinical Practice Standards: American Diabetes Association (ADA), American College of Cardiology (ACC), American Heart Association (AHA), Familiarity with ICD-10 and CPT-4 coding practices
  • Complete comprehensive, accurate and thorough review of the assigned member population, including timely completion and submission of all required encounter documentation (paper or electronic)
  • Ensure that all pertinent and active medical conditions are documented in the medical record in a manner compliant with CMS/DHHS, Company policy, and client requirements
  • Support the physician/patient relationship and ensure timely and adequate communication, documentation of assessment findings, recommendations, need for additional services, emergency services required if necessary and need for follow up and timelines for follow up to primary care provider (PCP) and health plan as required
  • Make general recommendations to members intended to improve members' knowledge of their chronic condition(s), such as information concerning recommended testing
  • Address and close identified gaps in care (disease-specific or preventive)
  • Recognize emergent or urgent situations requiring escalation and take appropriate action as specified in company policies, and as determined by reasonable professional judgment and ethical professional practice standards; and
  • Perform, document and communicate results of Point of Care (POC) Testing
  • Maintain compliance with Company policies, procedures and mission statement
  • Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within the Company’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position
  • Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company
  • Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function
  • On a monthly basis, be available for a minimum of 25 slots of availability per month (approximately 37 hours)
  • We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Active un-encumbered license to practice nursing
  • ANCC or AANP board certification as a Nurse Practitioner or Clinical Nurse Specialist in Family, Adult, Gerontology or Emergency Medicine.
  • Maintains current CPR certification
  • Compliance, prior to hire, with recommended Healthcare Personnel Requirements for vaccinations and preventive testing:
    • Hepatitis B
    • Influenza
    • MMR: Measles, Mumps and Rubella
    • Pertussis, Tetanus and diphtheria and acellular pertussis (Tdap)
    • Varicella
    • Tuberculosis
  • Home Health exp a plus
  • Must be able to effectively communicate with elderly and chronically ill patients and families
  • Understanding of Medicare, Medicaid and Health Plan benefit structures beneficial
  • Ability to multitask
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Bi-lingual or multi-lingual a plus
  • Ability to practice autonomously in a remote clinical environment, including independently conducting patient assessments, formulating evidence-based treatment plans, managing complex chronic conditions, and making sound clinical decisions without direct on-site supervision
  • Proficient with computer platforms, electronic health records (EHRs), secure messaging systems, and cloud-based documentation tools

This company utilizes E-Verify.

ComplexCare Solutions (CCS) is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. By embracing diversity, equity and inclusion we enhance our work environment and drive business success. ComplexCare Solutions (CCS) strives to reflect the diversity of the communities where we operate and of our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.

raw.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

The Manager, Software Engineering is responsible for leading and developing high-performing, cross-functional engineering teams, overseeing project execution, driving technical strategy, and aligning operations with Prenuvo's broader business objectives. In this role, you will balance technical leadership and people management to ensure your team delivers reliable, scalable, and impactful healthcare technology.

This role is responsible for delivery and integration of services centered around the Salesforce (Sales Cloud and Health Cloud) platform. This individual must apply

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Develop Talent and Technical Skills: Lead cross-functional engineering teams with an explicit focus on talent development. You are directly responsible for the awareness and development of essential technical skills within each team, fostering growth through regular 1:1s, ongoing mentorship, and clear career pathing.
  • Drive Agile Delivery: Own the day-to-day execution and delivery of your team. Champion agile methodologies to ensure predictable sprint cycles, high velocity, and timely project completion.
  • Provide Technical Leadership: Act as a hands-on technical mentor, guiding the team through complex architectural decisions, setting code quality standards, and participating in code reviews.
  • Align Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Security, and Marketing teams to define the product vision, prioritize the backlog, and ensure alignment on project scope and quality.
  • Ensure Quality & Compliance: Assure that engineering processes, system architecture, and documentation meet high-quality standards and applicable healthcare regulatory guidelines (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2).
  • Optimize Engineering Operations: Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements to enhance software development efficiency, maintainability, and team health.
  • Track Performance: Define and monitor key performance metrics to measure team productivity, code quality, and delivery timelines, communicating progress to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • 2+ years of direct people leadership and engineering management experience.
  • A People-First Leadership Philosophy: You have a proven ability to build and develop high-performing engineering teams through effective hiring, training, mentoring, and feedback. You don't just focus on the technical, mechanistic elements of software delivery; you prioritize developing and promoting genuine People Leaders.
  • A Culture-Driven Mindset: You intentionally cultivate a team culture that is creative, collaborative, curious, caring, and conscientious.
  • Strong technical background with demonstrated experience designing and delivering systems using: Python, React, TypeScript, Flask/FastAPI, Redux, NoSQL, and Serverless architectures.
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., AWS, CloudFormation, Terraform), including designing for scalability and supportability.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with a track record of partnering with product management to define vision and development priorities.
  • A passion for process improvement, agile methodologies, and aligning engineering efforts with the company's strategic objectives.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role is $220,000-$240,000 in local currency, depending on experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to .

Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!

Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT).

Visit our website:

Position: Market Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long Term

Salary Range: USD 950 - 1,200 / Month

Benefit: 10 PTO and HMO after the probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide

Job Summary:

Market Operations keeps our markets running: enough verified drivers on the road, every trip assigned before the day begins, and every trip completed on time. You'll own a piece of that and be measured on it. This is a decision-making role, not a scripted one — you'll make calls, act, and explain your reasoning afterward. If you're looking for phone-based client support with defined procedures, our Client Support Specialist opening is the better fit.

How your responsibilities are assigned

  • The responsibilities below cover everything Market Operations does across five areas. You will not be responsible for all of them.
  • During the hiring process, we'll evaluate where your strengths fit best, and you'll start in one area. Your assignment is confirmed before you accept the offer, so you'll know exactly what you're taking on. Over time, you'll be cross-trained into more.
  • Read this as the map of the team you're joining, and your starting point within it.

Responsibilities:

If assigned to Driver Onboarding & Activation

  • Make fast first contact with new driver applicants and guide them through the application
  • Run onboarding interviews, group and 1:1, and decide who advances
  • Review driver documents for accuracy and compliance, and coach applicants through corrections
  • Coordinate background checks and screenings, and follow up until cleared
  • Run activation calls so new drivers are confident on the app before their first trip
  • Keep the roster current: expiration outreach, reactivation checks, and removing inactive drivers

If assigned to Dispatch & Scheduling

  • Build driver schedules and assign trips against them
  • Sweep the current week for schedule gaps and fill them before trips go uncovered
  • Work inside our AI-assisted dispatching tools, producing and acting on the daily output
  • Flag where the tooling gets it wrong so it improves
  • Notify drivers of schedule changes

If assigned to OTP Specialist

  • Monitor on-time performance live and intervene before a trip goes late, not after
  • Own urgent trip reassignments end to end: the decision, driver contact, and resolution
  • Keep clients informed before they have to ask
  • Step in when leads are tied up so nothing waits in a queue

If assigned to Routing Specialist

  • Build and adjust routes for efficiency and reliability
  • Make sure drivers activate GPS well ahead of pickup
  • Chase and coach drivers who don't, before it becomes a data gap
  • Protect billing and claims accuracy by keeping trip data complete

If assigned to Market Associate

  • Cover a portion of all three areas above in a newer or smaller market
  • Shift week to week toward whatever is currently limiting the market
  • Flag early which area is about to break

Every Market Operations Associate, in every area

  • Own your daily and weekly targets, and know where you stand without being asked
  • Resolve problems in your area rather than handing them off
  • Escalate what's genuinely above your authority, with what you've already tried and what you recommend
  • Keep driver and trip records accurate in every system you touch
  • Improve the procedures you work from, and document the ones that don't exist yet
  • Cross-train as backup on one adjacent area
  • Bring us patterns, not just incidents

Requirements

Required

  • 2-4 years in operations, dispatch, logistics, or program coordination, a role where you owned an outcome, not just a queue
  • Sound judgment without a script. Much of this work has no procedure for the situation in front of you
  • Comfort with tradeoffs. Some days you can cover one trip or the other, not both, and you'll need to decide quickly and defend the call
  • Comfort being measured daily. You should want the scoreboard, not avoid it
  • Ability to hold several threads at once and switch between them without dropping any
  • Strong written and verbal communication — most areas involve daily calls with drivers
  • Composure when things break. Some days are interrupt-driven and won't go as planned
  • Detail accuracy where a missed date or wrong record has real consequences
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn new tools quickly
  • Willingness to work ET hours, including weekend or holiday rotation depending on assignment
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for video calls

Preferred

  • NEMT, healthcare transportation, or other regulated service experience
  • Dispatch, fleet, or last-mile operations background
  • Applicant tracking or recruiting platform experience
  • Experience running group interviews or high-volume onboarding
  • Experience with AI-assisted operational tooling

Requisition ID

2026-4543

Job Summary

The Communications Lead (Project Manager Informatics) manages information technology-related project activity supporting the VHA Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) in the stabilization, recovery, and Post Go-Live (PGL) operation of the Oracle Health Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), serving as the communications lead. The incumbent applies life cycle and project management methodologies to plan, execute, and track communications and change-support workstreams, managing cost, schedule, and performance while identifying and mitigating risks.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as Communications Lead: plan, coordinate, and manage the communications workstream, including scope, schedule, resources, and deliverables.
  • Manage IT/informatics project activities using established life cycle and project management methodologies; track cost, schedule, and performance progress.
  • Identify and mitigate risks to communications and change-support activities; escalate issues with proposed resolutions.
  • Direct and quality-review the work of communications and technical writing staff.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with change management, training, and informatics teams to align messaging with workflow and system changes.
  • Apply SAFe Lean-Agile principles and practices to drive value and sustain organizational change and operational excellence through high-performing Agile teams.
  • Prepare project-level inputs for weekly task reports, bi-monthly budget trackers, and monthly progress reports.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience managing Information Technology-related projects.
  • Experience with life cycle and project management methodologies, including tracking cost, schedule, and performance.
  • Experience with and demonstrated understanding of SAFe Lean-Agile principles and practices.

Desired Qualifications

  • PMP or equivalent project management certification.
  • Experience leading communications or change-focused workstreams in healthcare/health IT programs.
  • VA/VHA or federal health experience; familiarity with EHR modernization initiatives.

Additional Requirements (All Positions)

  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand the English language.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable VA background investigation at the Low Risk / NACI level, including electronic fingerprinting and e-QIP submission.

raw.description:
Position Summary

Join Daktronics and be part of a team that creates cutting-edge digital LED display technology and audio systems. Experience the thrill of working on projects that bring excitement to sports events, attract customers worldwide, and guide people in their daily lives.

 

At Daktronics, you’ll engage in meaningful work and have the chance to grow both personally and professionally. Our internships and student positions offer hands-on experience, mentorship, and the opportunity to develop a deep understanding of our products and industry practices.

You’ll have a mentor who will challenge you to find solutions, take initiative and develop a strong understanding of Daktronics products, practices, and procedures. We are committed to providing the resources and mentorship necessary to thrive in your position, ensuring you feel supported and are successful.

What will the work look like for me?

Our Accounting Intern will work in the finance/accounting department at Daktronics. The finance/accounting team serves Daktronics stakeholders – employees, customers, vendors, shareholders, and community. Our work is focused on enabling Daktronics’ success by being trusted advisors, guiding or supporting company compliance and risk management efforts, being operationally excellent, and developing ourselves and the team. We have the responsibility to prepare accurate financial statements, as well as provide useful financial information to various departments within Daktronics. As part of this responsibility, the accounting department assists in internal control design, subsidiary financial information, and other key business activities.  

Our Accounting Intern may experience the following areas:   

  • General ledger accounting and SEC reporting:    
    • Assist with month-end financial close processes.   
    • Journal entry maintenance. 
    • Accounts receivable and accounts payable duties.  
    • Preparation of schedules for SEC filings.  
    • Financial statement preparation and publication.  
    • Assist with financial statement audit and internal control audits.  
  • Cost Accounting:    
    • Assist with month-end reconciliation process.  
    • Maintain and publish key reports for manufacturing and inventory items.  
    • Assist in analysis of labor and overhead rates. 
    • Prepare analysis by various costing methodologies.  
  • Services Accounting:   
    • Support monitoring for system and transaction errors and make corrections.  
    • Assist with Services Accounting (billing, warranty accounting, and reporting).    
  • Other Areas:  
    • Sales Tax Filing (monthly/quarterly sales tax return preparation).  
    • Project accounting duties (monitoring under billings).  
    • Daily cash reporting and internal control testing.  
    • Cash flow monitoring and reporting.   

When will I work?

Our internships typically run from 11 January 2027 to 13 August 2027 or 17 May 2027 to 10 December 2027 with the possibility of adjusting the schedule to fit your academic calendar. 

Where is this opportunity located? 

In this position you have the flexibility to work remote from a U.S. home office or at the Brookings or Sioux Falls, SD Daktronics campuses.

What are the pay and perks?

The typical hiring range for this position is $18.00 to $20.00 per hour based on the location of Sioux Falls, SD. The actual offer will consider a wide range of factors, including relevant education, experiences, location, and applicable local legislation.

This position is eligible for a subset of our company benefits including employee discount program, employee assistance program, community donation program, unpaid time off, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, leaves, disability and accommodations. Information about Daktronics benefits can be found on our website Career Opportunities (daktronics.com) ( This information is intended to be a general overview and may be modified by Daktronics at any time.

Qualifications

To be considered for the Accounting Internship, we require the following:

Academic Requirements: 

  • Preferred applicants will be full-time students currently enrolled in an accredited Bachelor's degree program related to Accounting.
  • Completion of sophomore year in good academic standing. Only strong academic performers will be considered, with a preference to 3.0 GPA or greater.
  • Able to take a semester off from school to complete the internship, if not already graduated.
  • Must be able to commit to 40 hours per week.
  • Unofficial transcripts or web transcripts must be submitted with application.

Other Requirements:

  • Good oral and written communication skills, good organizational skills, self-motivation.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Daktronics does not sponsor, renew, or extend immigration visas for this position.

Desired Traits:

  • Avid interest in accounting and tax operations.  
  • Motivated to learn and become proficient in Daktronics specific ERP software.   
  • Proficient user of general Microsoft applications, including but not limited to Excel and Word.   
  • Self-motivated, flexible, organized, and strong need to work as a team player.   

Ready to make an impact? Apply now and start your journey with Daktronics.

Daktronics is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.description:
Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.
By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What's the opportunity?

As our Strategic Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving operational efficiency, scaling processes, and supporting strategic initiatives across the organization. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, detail-oriented executor, and skilled collaborator passionate about delivering impactful outcomes.

What will I be doing?

  • Act as the right-hand person to the regional manager, supporting daily operations, decision-making, and strategic initiatives across the region.
  • Lead and manage high-impact, cross-functional strategic projects that drive growth, efficiency, and scalability in the region.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key external partners, including acquirers, banks, regulators, and other stakeholders.
  • Analyze market dynamics, identify growth opportunities, and collaborate with internal teams (Product, Operations, Finance, Legal) to execute country strategies.
  • Support the regional manager in managing relationships with key merchants, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring exceptional service delivery.
  • Proactively identify, prioritize, and lead initiatives to improve the overall merchant onboarding experience and reduce time-to-revenue.
  • Drive the onboarding process for new merchants, ensuring all regulatory, compliance, and operational requirements are met efficiently and in accordance with local laws.
  • Collaborate closely with the Legal and Compliance teams to ensure adherence to local regulatory frameworks, including licenses, tax requirements, AML, and KYC obligations.
  • Work alongside the Compliance team to develop and implement robust frameworks for transaction monitoring and fraud prevention.
  • Monitor tax regulations and coordinate with internal and external tax advisors to ensure compliance and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Analyze country performance metrics, including Total Payment Volume (TPV), revenue targets, budget execution, and growth pipelines and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Collaborate with Finance and FP&A teams to ensure budget accuracy and alignment with regional growth targets.
  • Identify underperforming segments or countries and design turnaround strategies.
  • Identify bottlenecks in merchant activation and processing go-lives; proactively work with relevant teams to resolve issues and accelerate time-to-market.
  • Be the regional owner for internal audit preparation and follow-ups.
  • Develop and refine operational playbooks, frameworks, and best practices for country operations, with a focus on scalability and standardization.
  • Prepare business cases and recommendations to support strategic decisions, including market entries, partnership opportunities, and product launches.
  • Actively participate in regulatory meetings and industry forums, representing dLocal and strengthening our presence in the country.
  • Act as an ambassador of dLocal’s culture and values, both internally and externally.

What skills do I need?

  • Minimum of 5 years in operations management, strategy, or a related role
  • Experience in the Payments Industry, Fintechs, and Digital Banks
  • Familiarity with all business functions, including Legal, Finance, Product, and IT
  • Proven ability to manage large-scale projects and deliver results in a fast-paced environment, with a track record of top performance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Proficiency in operational tools such as Excel, project management software (e.g., Asana, Trello), and data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
  • Open to constant change in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment, a self-starter, open to working across time zones with teams all over the world
  • Fluent in written and verbal English
  • Availability to travel
  • Ability to establish a relevant business network

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:
- Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
- Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
- dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
Flexibility in how you work: We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!
Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

Serve as the first and central point of contact for the SEASAM Facility, including for researchers preparing proposals, funded Principal Investigators (PI), vessel and other facility operators (e.g., Multidisciplinary Instrumentation in Support of Oceanography (MISO) Facility, National Deep Submergence Facility (NDSF)) that require scientific or operational support from the SEASAM Facility. Track the University-National Oceanographic Laboratory System (UNOLS) Marine Facilities Planner (MFP) to identify funded projects that may need support and initiate PI contact. Set up internal and external meetings and maintain accessible documentation of meeting outcomes. Work with Operations Manager to develop support budgets for external users of the facility and as-required for the National Science Foundation. Bring scientific and logistical expertise to operational decisions regarding equipment and personnel.

Operational and Shipping Logistics 30%:

Utilize operational and logistical expertise to represent SEASAM in UNOLS scheduling meetings as required. Maintain an updated calendar of cruise dates, mobilization and demobilization information, personnel assignments, and synopses of equipment and consumable needs. Work with Operations Manager and Expedition Leads to coordinate shipping and travel related to SEASAM Facility activities. Collate shipping quotes and handle documentation of competition when applicable. Procure over-the-side insurance for equipment as required. Navigate radiation safety use considerations and documentation for shipping of radiation sources required for shipboard operations (e.g., sealed 137Cs source, CT-scanner, portable X-ray sources). Manage shipping and travel bookings for SEASAM equipment and personnel, including return shipping of recovered samples to designated repositories.

Inventory and Consumable Management 30%:

Manage assets and records of physical inventory status and location, both internally and on the UNOLS MFP. Contribute scientific and operational expertise to decisions surrounding equipment maintenance and development priorities. Coordinate with Operations Manager and Expedition Leads in budgeting for consumables, maintenance and repair of equipment. Oversee vendor contracts, including establishment of purchase orders and invoice submissions.

Community Liaison and Workforce Development 10%: Work collaboratively with the Impact Manager, Operations Manager, and Director to facilitate community input, workforce development (PI training, sea-going interns, etc.) and discovery of facility resources and data products. Collate technician post-cruise feedback and documentation on operational experiences to build institutional knowledge of seafloor sampling operations from UNOLS and non-UNOLS platforms.

Other duties as assigned.

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.

· Four years' experience in the broad field of marine geoscience, including:

  • Engagement with laboratory and shore-side research reliant on seafloor samples
  • Experience with seafloor sampling operations, including:
  • Cruise planning and logistics, including international shipping
  • Shipboard operation and deployment of seafloor sampling equipment, including jumbo piston corers
  • Operation and maintenance of instrument track systems (e.g., multi-sensor core loggers, CT-scanners, etc) used for characterization of samples at sea
  • Shipboard curation and archival of seafloor samples, including jumbo piston cores

Additional Qualifications

· Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to act as a liaison between scientists, vessel operators, and marine technicians

· Experience maintaining records, shared files, calendars, and basic documentation systems

· Proficiency with standard office software, including email, calendars, spreadsheets, and word processing

Preferred Qualifications

· Familiarity with the UNOLS system, its major facilities and the capabilities and limitations of its diverse research vessels

· Operational proficiency with the UNOLS MFP

Job Overview

COMPANY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. Our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enables the distribution of power, signal, and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers, medical technology, and more. With more than 85,000 employees, including 9,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 130 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat and Instagram.

BU / FUNCTION DESCRIPTION

Key markets of Digital Data Networks are Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud, Enterprise/Telecommunications, Tier 3/Business Retail Equipment (BRE), and Internet of Things (IoT). In these markets, we are driving growth and innovation with an industry-leading product portfolio and global manufacturing capabilities.
TE /448GB/shas specialized in socket products since 1970 and has developed a large size socket (>10K pin count), small pitch socket (<0.4mm pitch) for high-speed applications (224/448Gbps)

ROLE OBJECTIVE

As Principal R&D Product Development Engineer of the DDN socket team, you will focus on creating relationships with customer innovators and influencers, defining and driving technical activities, coordinating and facilitating technical engineering-related communications for internal/external customers, creating the product standard for a key technology, and contributing to the technical roadmap of the socket products.

Job Requirements

1. Concept Development & Design

  • Develop innovative design concepts and conduct feasibility studies to assess technical and commercial viability.
    • Collaborate with global Product Design Engineering (PDE) teams to accurately convert VOC and PRD into detailed design inputs for precise socket development.
    • Create simplified 3D models and perform signal integrity (SI) simulations using advanced tools such as Ansys HFSS to validate electrical signal performance.
    • Build and test prototype samples, execute design validation plans, and complete product qualification to finalize specifications.

2. Strategic & Leadership Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end product development of high-speed, fine-pitch, large-size sockets—from market definition, concept creation to design, review, and production release.
• Foster strong alignment between business and customer engineering teams to deepen market understanding and drive customer-centric innovation.
• Responsible for mentoring and training engineering teams in advanced mechanical design principles and signal integrity simulation methodologies, including hands-on guidance in using industry-standard tools such as Creo and Ansys HFSS, to ensure design robustness, performance optimization, and alignment with high-speed interconnect requirements.

3. Customer & Market Engagement

  • Collaborate closely with customers and internal stakeholders (Sales, System Architects, FAEs, and PMs) to capture clear Voice of Customer (VOC) and translate it into conceptual designs and preliminary product specifications.
    • Engage in early-stage pathfinding with customers to co-develop cutting-edge interconnect solutions that meet future technological needs.
    • Prepare and present engineering evaluations and proposals to customers, aligning solutions with application requirements and performance targets

4. Manufacturing Support & Quality Assurance
• Provide technical support to manufacturing and quality teams to ensure efficient ramp-up, process optimization, and safe product launches.
• Support cross-functional teams—including customers, Sales, PMs, and manufacturing sites—through DFMEA, testing, troubleshooting, and engineering analysis.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering; Master’s degree preferred.
    • Minimum of 5 years of work experience in mechanical design for high-speed interconnect products, with high-speed signal integrity knowledge preferred.
    • Direct customer design and support experience, including the ability to work with Field Application Engineers to troubleshoot customer problems and improve existing designs.
    • Design experience with high-speed servers, switches, and memory is a plus.
    • Understanding semiconductor IC packaging and fundamental test/burn-in methodology.
    • Expert-level knowledge of interconnect design or experience with high-speed connectors with PCIE Gen 6/7 compliance.
    • High level of competency in mechanical design tools such as Creo/SolidWorks.
    • Good level of competency in signal integrity analysis tools (Ansys HFSS, Keysight ADS).
    • Strong analytical capabilities to interpret simulation and lab data, identify issues, and provide solutions.
    • Six Sigma methodologies or other strong data analytics background is a plus.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Ability to work in a global environment, fluent in English (verbal/written), and able to collaborate across geographies.
    • Highly motivated, quick learner, and able to work independently.

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

raw.description:
What you can expect

The Security Engineer is responsible for security design and reviews across our products and services. The ideal candidate brings broad technical expertise and hands-on experience in end-to-end product security. In this role, you’ll collaborate with engineering teams to design, implement, and validate secure solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted security advisor, guiding architecture and reviewing implementation, particularly for new features or security enhancements. This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud and security technologies while making a direct impact on Zoom’s platform.

About the Team

The Security Architecture team is dedicated to ensuring Zoom releases and deploys secure products. We work with diverse engineering, compliance and DevOps teams across the organization to meet security goals and maintain compliance with established SLAs.

Responsibilities

  • Being a security subject-matter expert, guide engineering teams in end-to-end secure system design and implementation.

  • Conducting threat modeling, architecture review, security code review, security assessment, and security testing (web application, native application, web services, cloud-based services, and infrastructure assessments).

  • Performing cloud infrastructure reviews from a security perspective; the primary focus will be on AWS permissions and configuration issues within components like IAM and S3.

  • Performing an in-depth security review of new Zoom features and functionalities. This includes identifying security vulnerabilities such as those in the Owasp Top Ten, common issues from the NVD, and risks like RCE. It also involves reviewing Java or Python code and verifying security posture through manual and automated testing using tools like Burp Suite and Coverity.

  • Identifying gaps in existing cloud security architecture design/configuration, recommend changes or enhancements (authentication, authorization, network segmentation, container configuration, bastion host setup, etc.).

  • Providing hands on security training and secure coding best practices to engineering teams.

What we’re looking for

  • Have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Cyber Security, Computer or Electrical Engineering (or similar field), or equivalent experience, and 5+ years of experience in security.

  • Have extensive experience in security testing in various environments, including assessing the security posture of web applications, native applications, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS. Focus on securing web services, infrastructure, deployment, and platform core services.

  • Possess a solid understanding of software security architecture, design, threat modeling, secure code review, cryptography, and the SDLC. Ability to clearly communicate best practices and effective mitigations for application security, particularly SDLC exceptions.

  • Have hands on security experience working with AWS and common service components within AWS. Ability to identify security gaps in the overall design as well as configuration issues in individual components.

  • Have in-depth knowledge of network based, system level, and application layer attacks and mitigation methods.

  • Have good knowledge of technology and security topics including network and application security (Owasp), infrastructure hardening, security baselines, web server, database security and applied cryptography.

  • Have good development experience in one or more of the programming languages and platforms such as Java is required.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$98,900.00

Maximum:

$228,700.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations.

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.

Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.

About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment​

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives including qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records and any qualified applicants requiring reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.

Think of this opportunity as a marathon, not a sprint! We're building a strong team at Zoom, and we're looking for talented individuals to join us for the long haul. No need to rush your application – take your time to ensure it's a good fit for your career goals. We continuously review applications, so submit yours whenever you're ready to take the next step.

raw.description:
ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS

New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy. Our laser focus is on clean energy entrepreneurs: providing them with funds, accelerators, and networks to thrive. They are our main audience and our agent of change.

We started in California in 2004 and now operate across China, India, Southeast Asia, East and West Africa, and Australia. We have leveraged US$5.4 billion in investment and supported more than 11,000 entrepreneurs.

ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY

The Development team leads NEX’s fundraising efforts across the organization, bringing together global and local fundraising capabilities to strengthen relationships, grow funding, and support NEX’s programs and chapters. Because our fundraising work is distributed across countries and teams, strong systems, accurate data, and consistent processes are essential to making the most of our global network.

The Development Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and coordination support to the Development team, with a particular focus on maintaining accurate fundraising data and producing timely, useful reports. This role will manage routine data entry and upkeep in NEX’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system; follow up with staff to fill data gaps; and prepare monthly fundraising reports by extracting, organizing, checking, and presenting CRM data. The Development Coordinator will also support proposal and grant administration, donor communications, events, and other team needs.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organized, detail-oriented person who enjoys working with data and systems and is excited to build their skills in nonprofit fundraising and development.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

CRM & Fundraising Data

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date donor, contact, opportunity, and proposal information in the CRM.
  • Review CRM data regularly and identify missing, outdated, or inconsistent information.
  • Follow up with country and global development staff to collect missing information and update records.
  • Enter and update fundraising activity, contacts, opportunities, proposals, and other relevant information.
  • Add contacts and relevant data from other fundraising and marketing tools, such as Donorbox.
  • Conduct routine data checks and clean-up to maintain data quality.
  • Respond to basic CRM questions and escalate more complex questions to the appropriate Abundance team or IT staff.

Reporting & Spreadsheets

  • Produce NEX’s monthly fundraising report by reviewing CRM data, identifying data gaps, coordinating with staff to address them, and exporting and organizing information into a clear, polished report.
  • Maintain recurring fundraising tracking spreadsheets and dashboards.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports and data exports as requested by the Development team.
  • Check data for accuracy and consistency before reports are shared.
  • Help improve the organization and presentation of recurring reports and spreadsheets.

Fundraising & Grant Administration

  • Maintain organized electronic records for proposals, grants, and other fundraising materials.
  • Help track proposals and grant reporting deadlines and follow up with staff as needed.
  • Support the preparation and submission of proposals, reports, and other funder materials using NEX’s standard information and templates.
  • Assist with gathering and organizing information needed for funder and impact reports.
  • Help maintain standard fundraising materials, templates, and shared files.

Team & Event Support

  • Provide administrative support to the Development team, including scheduling, document preparation, data entry, and other coordination tasks.
  • Support donor communications, including quarterly funder newsletters and other emails sent through Mailchimp.
  • Assist with logistics for donor meetings, virtual funder calls, donor dinners, funder panels, and other events.
  • Provide other administrative and coordination support to the Development team as needed.

Requirements

Experience:

  • 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, coordination, operations, development, or similar role.
  • Experience working with a CRM, database, or other information management system (e.g. Zendesk Sell, Salesforce, Hubspot).
  • Experience working with spreadsheets, including organizing, cleaning, and presenting data in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Experience coordinating information or follow-up across multiple people or teams.
  • Nonprofit fundraising or grant experience is a plus, but not required.

Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Highly organized, with strong skills in document and file management.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort working with data.
  • Able to identify missing or inconsistent information and proactively follow up to resolve it.
  • Strong communication skills, including cross-cultural communication, listening,
  • responsiveness, and clear online communication.
  • Reliable and consistent in following through on recurring tasks and deadlines.
  • Comfortable learning new systems and processes, eagerness to learn and grow in
  • nonprofit fundraising and development.
  • Proficiency with online communication and collaboration tools such as Slack and Asana.
  • Scheduling flexibility to interface virtually with team members across time zones.
  • Self-starter with ability to check own work and ensure high quality deliverables

Benefits

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

This is a full-time remote position. Relocation assistance is not available for this role and compensation is competitive for the market the candidate is based in. Applicable benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays and insurance will depend on the location of the selected candidate.

TO APPLY, TIMELINE, AND PROCESS

  • Submit your resume, cover letter and responses to our application questions.
  • Click the “Apply” button below to begin your application.
  • Interview process: Qualified applicants will participate in a series of interviews via Zoom. There will be 2-3 rounds of interviews.
  • Accommodation: If you require accommodations during the interview process, please contact us with your request.

New Energy Nexus is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants or employees because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or gender identity or expression of an otherwise qualified individual, or membership in any other class protected by applicable law. New Energy Nexus hires and promotes individuals on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled. We strongly encourage diverse applicants to apply.

Company Overview:

At Shaper Capital, we're on a mission to partner with incredible people to build companies that shape the world. We're the company-building engine of Travis May, who co-founded and led the two largest data exits of the last 20 years: LiveRamp (NYSE: RAMP, $200M+ revenue) and Datavant ($7B merger with Ciox). Now he's applying that playbook to solve data fragmentation across every major industry, from healthcare to national security to supply chain to AI.

Since October 2023, Shaper has launched 8 companies and raised 100M+ from top firms like a16z, CRV, and Footwork. One portfolio company went from incorporation to a $10M raise in 6 weeks (Arbital Health). Another grew 20x in a single year and closed an 8-figure deal in its first year (Protege). Most recently, our co-founded company, Fractional AI, was acquired to anchor a massive new AI venture backed by Anthropic, Blackstone, and Hellman Friedman to deploy Claude at scale.

By joining Shaper today, you'll be part of a small, ambitious team driven by the belief that the world's greatest problems have yet to be solved and the most transformative companies have yet to be built. We empower our portfolio companies to create businesses that transform industries, and we believe in hiring individuals who are smart, nice, and get things done. We invest in hiring high-potential and humble individuals who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can rapidly grow their responsibilities as we reimagine company creation.

Role Overview:

As a Founding Engineer, you'll join one of Shaper's portfolio companies at the ground floor as the technical co-builder standing up the company's engineering foundation alongside its founder. You'll start from a blank slate and take wide ownership across the whole stack. You'll help define the architecture, ship the first version of the product, and make the technical calls that shape how the company builds for years to come.

As the first engineer, you'll also define what great looks like here; the practices and culture that will shape the engineering team as it scales.

This is a true 0-to-1 seat with room to grow as the company scales and a unique opportunity for an exceptional, hands-on generalist engineer to work shoulder-to-shoulder with a founding CEO and learn what it takes to build a category-defining company from the inside.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the Technical Foundation: Build the first version of the product end-to-end — from initial architecture decisions through shipping to real customers.
  • Partner Directly with the Founding CEO: Talk directly with the customers using the product and help set the technical direction and roadmap alongside leadership.
  • Establish Engineering Culture and Tooling: Help build the technical foundations, tooling, and engineering practices that the company will scale on as the team grows.
  • Work Across Every Lane of the Company: Engineering is your home base, but this role reaches into all of it — product, sales, customer service, and beyond — wherever the company needs you most.

Who you are:

  • You have strong generalist engineering experience — you've built and shipped real products, ideally as an early engineering hire (employee #1-10) at a startup or in another 0-to-1 capacity.
  • You move fluidly across the stack, pick things up quickly, and execute ruthlessly.
  • You're entrepreneurial, love working closely with customers, take ownership without waiting to be told, and bring scrappy energy to your work.
  • You make quick, thoughtful calls that balance short-term speed with long-term health.
  • You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) to move fast and iterate quickly, without sacrificing sound judgment on what ships.
  • You align with our motto of hiring people who are smart, nice, and get things done.

What We Offer:

  • A true ground-floor seat at a Shaper-backed company, with real ownership of the technical foundation.
  • Room to grow as the company scales, with the opportunity to shape engineering culture and technical direction from the very beginning.
  • Material equity in the ground floor of a company you're building from zero + competitive cash compensation and benefits.
  • The ability to join a working network of highly talented operators, engineers, and specialists collaborating across a multi-industry portfolio, all pressure-tested on solving hard problems.
  • Work directly with high agency operators embedded deep in early-stage startups, giving the company experienced technical, product, and talent support across multiple functions it couldn't otherwise access at this stage.

Project Ownership

  • Manage timelines, stakeholders, and quality to ensure successful execution.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews and implement continuous improvements.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Collaborate with subject matter experts and business partners to identify learning needs.
  • Translate business challenges into effective learning strategies and solutions.
  • Serve as a liaison across teams to ensure alignment, clarity, and successful delivery.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Evaluate learning effectiveness and recommend improvements based on data and feedback.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance the learner experience across LMS/LXP platforms.
  • Explore and implement emerging technologies to improve engagement and scalability.

What Success Looks Like

  • Learning solutions that clearly connect to behavior change and business outcomes
  • Increased learner engagement and on-the-job application
  • Strong partnerships where stakeholders view you as a trusted advisor—not just a content developer

Qualifications

Skills & Experience

    • Synthesia (AI video creation)
    • Camtasia or similar video editing tools
    • Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent)
  • Experience designing interactive, scenario-based, and microlearning experiences
  • Strong understanding of instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and performance measurement
  • Experience with LMS platforms and familiarity with Learning Experience Platforms (LXP)
  • Working knowledge of SCORM, xAPI, and learning analytics
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to work independently and drive projects with minimal supervision.

Pay Range:

  • $66,500.00 - $92,000.00/annually

Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Associate Solutions Architect for GitLab's SMB EMEA Sales team, you'll be a trusted advisor to GitLab prospects and customers, helping them understand how GitLab's DevSecOps platform addresses both technical requirements and business objectives across the entire software development lifecycle. You'll guide organizations through their digital transformation journeys, from planning through monitoring, using your technical expertise, understanding of cloud and modern software development practices, and strong customer empathy. Reporting to a regional Solutions Architect manager and partnering closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, you'll own technical evaluations (including proof of value initiatives and workshops), shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management. You'll focus on driving successful platform adoption, influencing revenue growth through solution selling, and building long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.

What you'll do

  • You help drive value and change with software development for one of the fastest-growing platforms. By applying solution selling and architecture experience from planning to monitoring, you also support and enable the successful adoption of the GitLab platform by our SMB EMEA Customers. You work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing organizations to realize customer value. Key milestones include:
    • In the first 30 days, successful completion of the Solutions Architect Onboarding plan.
    • Within two months, collaborate closely with your peers to gain comprehensive knowledge of the GitLab platform, DevOps practices, and associated technologies and learn through shadowing our value selling approach.
    • Within three months you start to engage with customers, both onsite and remote, in a technical consultancy and advisor role during the pre-sales process while providing technical assistance and solution guidance.
  • In partnership with the sales team, you formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue targets through the adoption of GitLab.

  • You guide technical evaluations via POC/POV ownership, RFP/audit support, and workshop design.
  • You build relationships with people within customer environments to enable them to be GitLab advocates.
  • Serve as the customer advocate to other GitLab teams, including Product Development, Sales, and Marketing.
  • Continuously improve your professional skills with a focus on personal mastery and team learning through activities such as training, reading, and seeking mentorship from others.
  • Maintain specialty competency in one or more technologies related to GitLab's market focus through activities such as training, certification, and creation of working examples for reuse internally and by customers and partners

What you'll bring

We, the Solutions Architect team, are part of GitLab's Sales organization and serve as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role focused on opportunities across our SMB EMEA Sales Segmentation and reporting into a regional Solutions Architect Manager. As a Sr. National Account Manager you will be responsible for the strategic direction and management of assigned account(s) and will be accountable to deliver revenue and/or profitability targets. In addition to selling, this role will be responsible for activities such as forecasting and budget management. This role will require cross-functional collaboration and leadership.
